title: Studio future weekly Rivalry line-up command
description: Owner-only POST /v1/admin/rivalry-plans/{plan_id}/preview accepts the edit fields without preview_at/preview_hash. POST /commands accepts the complete command. Exactly five distinct eligible latest immutable track versions are required. The server checks the active vehicle/build, expected revision, five-minute preview and UTC start deadline. A committed command_id is a permanent replay identity. GET /v1/admin/rivalry-plans returns the current locked week plus four future UTC weeks for the requested vehicle; it never creates plans. POST /prepare fills missing weeks and records an audit. The existing worker performs automatic planning at most once a minute across workers.
